name: Qatar Airways Student Club
summary: Free Qatar Airways club for university students aged 18 to 30 with rising flight discounts, extra baggage and free date changes.
key: Save 10% on your first flight, 15% on your second flight and 20% on your third and fourth flights.
who: Enrolled at an accredited college or university for a duration of up to 4 years.
how: Complete the SheerID verification process to join Student Club.
catches: Extra 10kg or one more piece of baggage, depending on route.

evidence.quote: Save 10% on your first flight, 15% on your second flight and 20% on your third and fourth flights.
You need to be between the ages of 18 and 30 years old.
